  bach upgrade hub                  Upgrade hub handlers

  1. Single file     -> Upgrade one specific file
  2. Category        -> All files in a category (e.g. hub/)

  - Hash verification before/after upgrade
  - Backup before change
  - Rollback on error

  bach upgrade core
  bach upgrade hub/settings.py
